summary: The Tabs feature is implemented but untested, because I was asked not to run tests. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges and yields one Text; Opacity keeps existing style attributes; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added in test_underline_bar.py, test_opacity.py, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Nothing is committed. Review points: the bar indexes displayed tabs so duplicate names underline correctly; the layout resolver is unchanged because min_size already exists there; click actions are written as range_clicked('name'); the optional sandbox demo was skipped. The background search I started earlier was stopped at its time limit and changed nothing.
